# Rojes Labs — Assam TeaTrace (NESFIC-I-08)

> End-to-end digital traceability platform for the Assam tea value chain, developed for NESFIC 2026 Problem Statement NESFIC-I-08 (Tea Research Association – Tocklai).

## Lead Applicant & Organization
- **Lead Applicant**: Pratibha Das Hatibaruah
- **Submitting Entity**: Rojes Labs
- **Region**: Assam, India (IN-AS)
- **Challenge**: North East Seva First Innovation Challenge (NESFIC) 2026 — NESFIC-I-08
- **Live URL**: https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Pratibhadas3108/rojes-assam-teatrace

## Key Routes (SEO & GEO Friendly)
- `/` — Assam Tea Value Chain Traceability Ledger & Digital Product Passport Explorer (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/)
- `/trace-simulator` — Interactive Farm-to-Cup Batch & QR Provenance Simulator (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/trace-simulator)
- `/compliance-audit` — Assam GI Origin, Mass-Balance & MRL Export Compliance Audit (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/compliance-audit)
- `/proposal` — Complete 12-Section NESFIC-I-08 Proposal & Downloadable PDFs (https://rojes-assam-teatrace.pages.dev/proposal)
